domain: Clinical Trials Electronic Data Capture (FDA 21 CFR Part 11)
title: $4.8M Global Oncology EDC Deployment for Meridian BioPharma Phase II/III Trials
executive_summary: Meridian BioPharma proposes to deploy a validated Cloud EDC platform across 240 global sites for Phase II/III oncology trials under a 3-year $4.8M agreement. The deal promises full FDA 21 CFR Part 11 compliance with cryptographic e-signatures, blinded segregation, and rapid migration, but technical specifications reveal critical gaps in uptime, scalability, and audit readiness.

proposal_document.title: Commercial Proposal v1.0
proposal_document.text:
Meridian BioPharma will receive our Validated Cloud EDC platform for Phase II/III oncology trials. Our Validated Cloud EDC platform guarantees 99.99% uptime with zero scheduled downtime during active trial phases, includes unlimited concurrent sites and subjects at a fixed fee of $485,000 per year, and provides FDA 21 CFR Part 11 compliant cryptographic e-signatures with biometric two-factor authentication for all investigator sign-offs. The system supports 240 global sites with sub-second eCRF load times and real-time edit checks across all treatment arms.

We commit to real-time blinded data segregation with automated unblinding prevention across all 240 global sites, instant immutable audit trails available for FDA inspection within 5 seconds, and full legacy migration of 12 years of historical trial data within 14 days at no additional cost. All validation documentation (IQ/OQ/PQ) and 24/7 dedicated clinical support with 15-minute critical incident response are included in the base price with no additional validation fees.

technical_specification.title: Technical Architecture Spec v4.2
technical_specification.text:
The Technical Architecture Spec v4.2 defines the EDC as a multi-tenant AWS-hosted system with 99.5% uptime SLA excluding maintenance, and requires a 6-hour scheduled maintenance window every Sunday 02:00-08:00 UTC during which the EDC is offline for database patching and backup validation. All investigator e-signatures use FIPS 140-2 validated cryptographic modules with biometric two-factor authentication per FDA 21 CFR Part 11.50 and 11.70, with private keys stored in AWS CloudHSM and timestamped via RFC 3161 TSA.

Blinded and unblinded data are segregated via role-based access controls, but manual sponsor review is required to approve unblinding events, and audit trail exports are generated as batch reports with best-effort retrieval times depending on system load and archive tiering up to 4 hours. The platform supports up to 150 concurrent sites and 10,000 subjects per study, with eCRF load times under 3 seconds under nominal load, and data migration services are scoped separately under professional services SOW.

commitments.claim: 99.99% uptime with zero downtime during active trials
commitments.proposal_quote: guarantees 99.99% uptime with zero scheduled downtime during active trial phases
commitments.spec_quote: requires a 6-hour scheduled maintenance window every Sunday 02:00-08:00 UTC during which the EDC is offline
commitments.explanation: Proposal promises zero scheduled downtime, while spec mandates a weekly 6-hour offline window, directly contradicting availability during active trial phases and violating the 99.99% SLA.

commitments.claim: Free 14-day migration of 12 years historical trial data
commitments.proposal_quote: full legacy migration of 12 years of historical trial data within 14 days at no additional cost
commitments.explanation: Spec makes no provision for 12-year historical migration in 14 days and explicitly states migration services are scoped separately under professional services SOW, leaving cost, timeline, and Part 11 data integrity for legacy data unsupported.

commitments.claim: Instant 5-second immutable audit trails for FDA inspection
commitments.proposal_quote: instant immutable audit trails available for FDA inspection within 5 seconds
commitments.spec_quote: audit trail exports are generated as batch reports with best-effort retrieval times depending on system load
commitments.explanation: Proposal guarantees 5-second retrieval, while spec describes best-effort batch generation dependent on load with up to 4-hour archive delays, leaving FDA inspection readiness and 21 CFR Part 11.10(e) audit trail timeliness uncertain.

commitments.claim: Part 11 compliant cryptographic e-signatures with biometric 2FA
commitments.proposal_quote: provides FDA 21 CFR Part 11 compliant cryptographic e-signatures with biometric two-factor authentication for all investigator sign-offs
commitments.spec_quote: All investigator e-signatures use FIPS 140-2 validated cryptographic modules with biometric two-factor authentication per FDA 21 CFR Part 11.50 and 11.70
commitments.explanation: Spec confirms the sales claim by detailing FIPS 140-2 validated modules, biometric two-factor authentication, CloudHSM key storage, and explicit compliance with Part 11.50 and 11.70 signature requirements.
